label: MRtrix3 tckedit
description:
Perform various editing operations on track files

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: maxlength
parameters.description: set the maximum length of any streamline in mm
parameters.usage: set the maximum length of any streamline in mm  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: minlength
parameters.description: set the minimum length of any streamline in mm
parameters.usage: set the minimum length of any streamline in mm  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: number
parameters.description: set the desired number of selected streamlines to be propagated to the output file
parameters.usage: set the desired number of selected streamlines to be propagated to the output file  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: skip
parameters.description: omit this number of selected streamlines before commencing writing to the output file
parameters.usage: omit this number of selected streamlines before commencing writing to the output file  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: maxweight
parameters.description: set the maximum weight of any streamline
parameters.usage: set the maximum weight of any streamline  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: minweight
parameters.description: set the minimum weight of any streamline
parameters.usage: set the minimum weight of any streamline  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: inverse
parameters.description: output the inverse selection of streamlines based on the criteria provided; i.e. only those streamlines that fail at least one selection criterion, and/or vertices that are outside masks if provided, will be written to file
parameters.usage: output the inverse selection of streamlines based on the criteria provided; i.e. only those streamlines that fail at least one selection criterion, and/or vertices that are outside masks if provided, will be written to file Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: ends_only
parameters.description: only test the ends of each streamline against the provided include/exclude ROIs
parameters.usage: only test the ends of each streamline against the provided include/exclude ROIs Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: save_tck_weights_out
parameters.description: specify the path for an output text scalar file containing streamline weights
parameters.usage: specify the path for an output text scalar file containing streamline weights Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: tck_weights_in
input_slots.description: specify a text scalar file containing the streamline weights

output_slots.label: tracks_out
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Perform various editing operations on track files

output_slots.label: tck_weights_out
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory.
